content:
maria: Heads-up — planning a config change for dedicated GPU pools in prod. Target deploy at 18:00 UTC today. Change is an autoscale tweak: lower scale-up threshold from 70% -> 60% and bump burst_cap for prod-gpu-2. Canary at 10% traffic, then 100% if green. Will run smoke tests and keep rollback ready. Any blockers?
aj: Which exact pools are affected? prod-gpu-1/prod-gpu-2 or others? Also, do we need a maintenance window?
maria: Affected: prod-gpu-1, prod-gpu-2, and prod-gpu-burst (the new burst pool). No DB or schema work. Maintenance window not required but plan for a ~15m rollout and monitoring. Canary on 10% of inference traffic routed to modified policy. Rollback plan: revert policy and scale down burst pool if error rate >1% or latency >200ms sustained for 3 minutes.
ranjit: I'll own the smoke checks and monitoring during the rollout. I'll post graphs to the #outages channel and watch tail of model-serving logs. When do you want me ready?
maria: Please be ready by 17:45 UTC so we can run pre-deploy checks. Deploy at 18:00; expected finish ~18:15. @aj will handle the live deploy step.
ci-bot: Deployment pipeline queued: https://ci.redwood.ai/pipelines/5678 — job id #deploy-prod-gpu-policy-2026-03-18. Logs will stream here once started.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy for 1760865600 initiated by maria. Will announce start/finish and provide rollback actions.
sylvia: Quick ask — can we include a perf smoke that verifies end-to-end latency and a small QPS ramp? Suggest these checks before flipping canary to 100%:

```
# ping health endpoints
curl -sS https://prod.redwood.ai/health | jq .status
# small inference sample to ensure model warming
python -c "import requests; r=requests.post('https://prod.redwood.ai/v1/generate', json={'model':'rwd-13b','input':'hello'}); print(r.elapsed.total_seconds(), r.status_code)"
# ramp: hit 5 qps for 60s against canary url
siege -c5 -t60s https://canary.prod.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

Also check KV cache hitrate on the dashboard and GPU mem utilization.
ranjit: Copy. I'll run the above smoke tests at 17:50 UTC and post results here. If health ok and latency median <150ms and error rate <0.5% then we proceed to canary.
aj: I'll be on-call for the deploy and ready to roll back. Ping me at 17:55 if anything looks flaky. :thumbsup:
maria: Final: start at 18:00 UTC. Canary -> monitor 10 minutes -> if green, push to 100% over 5 minutes. Rollback command (single-line):

```
# rollback to previous autoscale policy
redwoodctl pools update-policy --env prod --policy previous --pools prod-gpu-1,prod-gpu-2,prod-gpu-burst
```

Contact list: @ranjit (monitoring), @aj (deploy), @sylvia (perf checks). I'll post final go/no-go at 17:58. Thanks everyone :rocket:
